{{Quote|Falner wants our notes on various families and unaligned worlds in the Questal Sector. He means to bring that sector into the Empire.|Vector Hyllus|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Questal sector''' was in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in this [[Sector/Legends|sector]] included [[Nathas I]] and [[Questal/Legends|Questal]] itself.
